Does a te-tunnel denote the requested end-to-end client connectivity service, or an internal TE construct realizing such a service? Please give a gloss, example, and endpoint/topology relations.
What information does an otn-label encode? Please explain whether it expresses multiplexing/layer structure such as ODU2 mapped into OTU4, and give its relations.
What exactly is a tunnel-connection-endpoint? Please give a gloss, example, and relations to tunnels, nodes, and tunnel-termination-points.

answers.gloss: A termination-point is the node-local endpoint at which a TE link terminates.
answers.example: tp-R1-R2 is the termination point on R1 for the R1-R2 TE link.
answers.relations: It is on i.tenode and terminates i.telink. It is an ordinary topology/link endpoint, unlike i.ttp, which is a tunnel trail head.

answers.gloss: A tunnel-termination-point is the point where an end-to-end TE tunnel originates or terminates—a trail head.
answers.example: ttp-A1 is the head of the A1-A3 ODU2 tunnel at node A1.
answers.relations: It is on i.tenode and originates or terminates i.tunnel. It differs from i.tp because it terminates a tunnel rather than a TE link. The model does not explicitly characterize it as an external service-access interface, so equivalence to a service-interface-point requires verification.

answers.gloss: A TE tunnel is an end-to-end traffic-engineered construct that realizes a service; in this model it is itself classified as a service.
answers.example: tunnel-a1a3-odu2 is an ODU2 tunnel from A1 to A3.
answers.relations: It runs between i.ttp trail heads, is routed over i.tetopo, contains or is associated with i.tcep endpoints within nodes, and may be labeled by i.otnlabel. Whether A's connectivity-service denotes this same realized construct or instead the distinct client request remains to be established.

answers.gloss: An OTN label encodes the tributary-slot and tributary-port-number multiplexing structure used to carry an ODU signal in a higher-order OTN container.
answers.example: The TS/TPN allocation for carrying an ODU2 in an OTU4.
answers.relations: It labels i.tunnel and expresses OTN multiplex placement/layer structure rather than naming the tunnel or topology itself.

answers.gloss: A tunnel-connection-endpoint is a node-local endpoint of the tunnel's connection within a node.
answers.example: tcep-a1a3-R1 is the connection endpoint for the A1-A3 tunnel on R1.
answers.relations: It is on i.tenode and is part of i.tunnel. No direct relation from i.tcep to i.ttp is asserted in model B: i.ttp is the tunnel trail head, whereas i.tcep represents a connection endpoint within a node.

answers.gloss: A link-termination-point is a node-owned edge point where a topological link terminates.
answers.example: nep-R1-R2 is the R1 edge point toward R2 on link-R1-R2.
answers.relations: It is on t.node and terminates t.link. It is a topology/link endpoint, not a service-access point or connection endpoint.

answers.gloss: A service-interface-point is the externally exposed point through which a client service accesses the network.
answers.example: sip-A1-odu is the ODU2 client hand-off at A1.
answers.relations: It is on t.node and provides access to t.cs. It is specifically an external service-access interface, not merely a tunnel trail head. The decisive experiment refuted identity with i.ttp.

answers.gloss: A connectivity-service is the end-to-end connectivity service delivered across the network; model A represents the service together with its network realization rather than separately modeling a client request and a TE tunnel.
answers.example: cs-a1a3-odu2 is the ODU2 connectivity service from A1 to A3.
answers.relations: It uses t.sip access points, is realized by t.cep connection endpoints, and runs over t.topo.

answers.gloss: A layer-protocol-qualifier expresses the multiplexing and layer structure of a signal.
answers.example: ODU2 mapped into an OTU4 server container.
answers.relations: It qualifies t.cs and captures client/server layer and multiplex-placement semantics. Its scope may be broader than a concrete OTN TS/TPN label, so identity with i.otnlabel requires invariant testing.

answers.gloss: A connection-end-point is a node-local endpoint of the connection that realizes a connectivity service.
answers.example: cep-a1a3-R1 is the A1-A3 service connection endpoint on R1.
answers.relations: It is on t.node and part of t.cs. Model A asserts no direct relation from t.cep to t.sip; the SIP is the external access point, while the CEP is an endpoint of the internal service connection.
